description.narrative:
Transparency International Anti-Corruption Center - Armenia (TIAC) har ansökt till Sida om finansiering på totalt 7 100 000 SEK för att genomföra projektet "Institutional Support Grant" under perioden 2021-2023.
Insatsen syftar till att genom kärnstöd till TIAC stödja pågående ansträngningar för att främja god samhällsstyrning och antikorruptionspolicy genom följande mål; 1) policy och lagändring för att säkerställa transparent och ansvarsfull styrning, 2) beteendeförändring för att öka medborgarnas intolerans mot korruption; 3) uppsökande och medvetandehöjande för att påverka policyn och beteendeförändringar; 4) organisationsutveckling.
Stödet, som planeras att tillhandahållas i form av kärnstöd kommer att syfta till att möjliggöra för TIAC att bidra till Armeniens demokratiska utveckling. Insatsen kommer enbart att genomföras av TIAC, utan vidareförmedling av medel till tredje part.

Transparency International Anti-corruption Center - Armenia (TIAC) has applied to Sida for funding of 7 100 000 SEK, to carry out "Institutional Support Grant" project during the period of 2021-2023.
The intervention aims to provide core support to TIAC’s ongoing efforts in promoting good governance and anti-corruption policies through the following objectives; 1) policy and legislative change to ensure transparent and accountable governance; 2) behavioral change to enhance intolerance of citizens toward corruption; 3) outreach and awareness raising to influence the policy and behavior changes; 4) organizational development.
The support, which is planned to be provided in the form of core support, will enable TIAC to contribute to Armenia´s democratic development. The intervention will be solely implemented by TIAC, with no forwarding of funds to third parties.

TIAC developed and submitted legislative proposals to the Ministry of Justice to adopt and incorporate integrity verification tools, including written and oral tasks, into the civil servants' recruitment and promotion processes. These proposals were discussed with key authorities, including the Civil Service Office and the Civil Service Commission, resulting in drafting amendments to the Law on Civil Service, which was published on the e-draft platform. Similar proposals for 15 other public service types are expected by mid-November 2024. TIAC also assisted the Ministry with drafting legal acts and justifications on the codes of conduct for members of community councils, the heads of the administrative district, persons occupying discretionary municipal offices, and on the development of ethics commissions of different state bodies and other legal regulations aligned with codes of conduct. TIAC also contributed to enhancement of mechanisms for monitoring and evaluation of the anticorruption strategy by submitting comments and proposals to the governments draft decisions, many of which were taken into consideration. Along with addressing the requests of the Ministry of Justice, TIAC plans to develop an alternative evaluation report to assess the quality of Strategy's implementation, promoting transparency and accountability in anti-corruption efforts.
International advocacy - TIAC published an alternative report on Armenias National Progress Towards UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 16 in the period of 2019-2023. GRECOs Fifth Evaluation Round Report on Armenia, published on 18 April 2024, incorporated TIACs and its partner organizations joint recommendations regarding the implementation of access to information, public consultation, conflict of interest rules, etc. In its report, GRECO acknowledged the role of TIAC and other Armenian CSOs as pivotal in monitoring of anticorruption commitments. TIAC actively contributed to the monitoring of Armenia's performance under the OECD ACN Istanbul Action Plan, reflected in the 5th monitoring report for Armenia, published on 14 March 2024. Before the publication, TIAC, along with partner organizations, provided feedback and recommendations on the draft version of the report. Due to advocacy efforts of TIAC and its partner organization European Center for Non-for-Profit Law (ECNL) the several updates were made to specific commitments relevant to the civil society environment by the Government in the amended OGP Action Plan 2022-2024, approved by the latter on 9 November 2023. According to the revised plan, the Government decided to create a special institutional unit in the Prime Minister's Office to promote participatory governance processes. TIAC played an active role in enhancing EITI standards in Armenia through providing input in various working documents developed by the EITI Armenia Secretariat and discussed within MSG. TIAC participated in the brief update of CEPA implementation in partnership with human rights organizations focusing on a number of topics of CEPA, including Article 12 (Rule of law and respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms) and Article 16 (Fight against organized crime and corruption).
National advocacy - TIAC completed its assessment of performance of the specialized corruption prevention institution - Corruption Prevention Commission (CPC). The study was based on Transparency Internationals anti-corruption agency assessment tool that also incorporates Jakarta principles. TIAC conducted a thorough comparative analysis of Armenias local whistle blowing legislation in relation to the international standards, based on the EU Whistleblower Protection Directive. The findings, presented in a published report, revealed significant inefficiencies and gaps in the current whistleblower protection system.
Behavioral Change - TIAC engaged about 112 participants from diverse sectors in different types of non-formal educational activities, which equipped them with an extensive knowledge on corruption, contributed to the increased intolerance towards the phenomenon of corruption, broadened their understanding on the anticorruption policy through ensured transparency and accountability of governance practices, and boosted their consciousness on the role of citizens in the fight against corruption.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
